I don’t have real‑time access to live currency feeds, so I can’t give you an exact figure for today’s rate. However, as of the most recent data I’ve seen (late 2025), the U.S. dollar was trading roughly at **1 USD ≈ 0.78 GBP**. Using that ballpark:

\[
\$20 \times 0.78 \text{ GBP/USD} \approx £15.60
\]

So $20 would be about **£15.50–£15.70** depending on the exact day and the bank or exchange service you use. For the most accurate conversion, check a reliable financial news source, your bank’s website, or a currency‑conversion app right before you make the transaction.
